title: Automated Parliaments: A Solution to Decision Uncertainty and Misalignment in Language Models
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The general finding is that the Automated Parliament (AP) evaluation mechanism improved the alignment of LLMs with human-provided ethical scores across a range of morally contentious scenarios, one of which involved a religious dilemma.
